top_signals.title: Tanker Carrying Qatari LNG Struck While Transiting Hormuz
top_signals.summary: A liquefied natural gas tanker carrying a shipment from Qatar was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, according to security intelligence firms and ship tracking data, threatening to further disrupt deliveries of the super-chilled fuel through the key waterway.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
